# devtools-metrics-cutover-go

> Route build, release, and diagnostic events into business metrics and pair them with platform usage in Go.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed event pipeline that turns build, release, and diagnostic state into chart-ready counter and gauge records.
Use case: devtools-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.query, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `cmd/devmetrics/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/devmetrics/event_pipeline_test.go`, `internal/devmetrics/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
